program.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Change the image into pencil drawing
requirements.source_phrase: Change the image into pencil drawing

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a pencil drawing.
outcomes.target: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing, with its visual content represented in a pencil-drawn style.
outcomes.reference: The supplied image and the requested pencil-drawing transformation.

checks.question: Does the image visibly appear as a completed pencil drawing?
checks.complete_when: The image is visibly rendered throughout as a pencil drawing.
checks.partial_when: Visible pencil-drawing treatment is present, but the transformation is incomplete or only affects part of the image.
checks.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no pencil-drawing transformation has been made.
checks.unknown_when: The image or its style cannot be assessed confidently.

requirements.text: Change the image into pencil drawing
requirements.source_phrase: Change the image into pencil drawing

outcomes.description: Transform the supplied photograph into a pencil drawing while preserving the recognizable scene and depicted objects.
outcomes.target: The entire image, including the meal and surrounding tableware and background objects, has a clearly visible pencil-drawn appearance with drawn contours and pencil-like shading or texture. The original scene and arrangement remain recognizable.
outcomes.reference: Compare the edited image with the supplied source image to assess whether a pencil-drawing treatment is visibly applied across the full image and the source scene remains recognizable.

checks.question: Does the edited image visibly transform the full source scene into a pencil drawing while keeping its content recognizable?
checks.complete_when: Pencil-like drawn contours and shading or texture are clearly evident throughout the image, including the meal and surrounding objects, and the source scene remains recognizable.
checks.partial_when: A pencil-like treatment is visible and some source content remains recognizable, but the effect is weak, inconsistent, limited to parts of the image, or much of the scene still appears photographic rather than clearly drawn.
checks.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no pencil-drawing treatment has been applied: the image remains essentially photographic or otherwise lacks visible pencil-like contours and shading.
checks.unknown_when: The edited image or its style cannot be assessed confidently.
